<!--
Shared LaTeX macros, included at the top of every post.

Pandoc expands these inside math before MathJax or LaTeX sees it, so they
behave the same on the web page and in the PDF. They use \providecommand
rather than \newcommand so that a name LaTeX already defines (like \P or \S)
doesn't stop the PDF from building; your definition still wins inside math.
-->

\providecommand{\FF}{\mathbb{F}}
\providecommand{\RR}{\mathbb{R}}
\providecommand{\CC}{\mathbb{C}}
\providecommand{\ZZ}{\mathbb{Z}}
\providecommand{\NN}{\mathbb{N}}
\providecommand{\QQ}{\mathbb{Q}}
\providecommand{\EE}{\mathbb{E}}
\providecommand{\PP}{\mathbb{P}}
\providecommand{\abs}[1]{\left|#1\right|}
\providecommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert#1\right\rVert}
\providecommand{\set}[1]{\left\{#1\right\}}
\providecommand{\floor}[1]{\left\lfloor#1\right\rfloor}
\providecommand{\ceil}[1]{\left\lceil#1\right\rceil}
\providecommand{\cP}{\mathcal{P}}
\providecommand{\cL}{\mathcal{L}}
